title: Origin of Adjustment Team: Philip K. Dick's bathroom light chain replaced by a switch

tellings.quote: Tessa, his wife, she told me that he came up with the idea for that story, which eventually became the movie The Adjustment Bureau, with Matt Damon and Emily Blunt, because he went into the bathroom and there was a light that he had turned on and off many times.

plain: The science fiction writer Philip K. Dick got the idea for his story Adjustment Team, later made into the film The Adjustment Bureau, after the pull chain on his bathroom light seemed to have turned into a wall switch, as though reality had been quietly changed. A researcher named Riz Virk tells this second-hand, from what Dick's wife Tessa Dick told him: "he went into the bathroom and there was a light that he had turned on and off many times." Virk tells it as a hint that the world might be a kind of simulation that can be edited.
